name: Single-Agent Methotrexate (8-Day Methotrexate/Folinic Acid) for Low-Risk GTN

biomarkers.note: Low risk GTN is a clinical/staging category (FIGO stage I to III with prognostic score less than 7), not a molecular biomarker gate. Single agent methotrexate is first line monotherapy for low risk disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia v2.2026, Systemic Therapy for GTN, Regimens for Low-Risk GTN (GTN-D).

treatmentSetting: curative-intent primary therapy for low-risk GTN
lineOfTherapy: first line single agent monotherapy for low risk (FIGO stage I to III, prognostic score less than 7) gestational trophoblastic neoplasia

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: low risk GTN (FIGO stage I to III with prognostic score less than 7)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: Low-Risk Disease section (lines 176987 to 176992, prognostic score < 7)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate renal function (methotrexate is renally cleared)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: ISMP/label based, leucovorin rescue built into the 8-day schedule

drugs.name: Methotrexate

provenance.locator: GTN-D 1 of 7, Regimens for Low-Risk GTN, Preferred: Methotrexate 1 mg/kg IM every other day x 4 days (Days 1, 3, 5, and 7), repeat every 14 days (category 1)

drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 1 of 7 (category 1). Methotrexate 1 mg/kg IM (or IV) on days 1, 3, 5, and 7, alternating every other day with leucovorin rescue on days 2, 4, 6, and 8; repeat every 14 days. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.2 (line 176999) prints the identical 8-day MTX/FA regimen (MTX 1 mg/kg IM or IV on days 1, 3, 5, 7). Requires adequate renal function; verify renal function before each course.

drugs.name: Leucovorin (folinic acid)

provenance.locator: GTN-D 1 of 7, Leucovorin 0.1 mg/kg rounded up to the nearest 5-mg increment or 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM 30 hours after each methotrexate dose on Days 2, 4, 6, and 8

drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 1 of 7. Leucovorin rescue 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM given 30 hours after each methotrexate dose on days 2, 4, 6, and 8. Source stated weight based alternative: 0.1 mg/kg rounded up to the nearest 5-mg increment. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.2 (line 177001) prints FA 15 mg PO on days 2, 4, 6, 8. Leucovorin rescue is mandatory in this schedule.

regimen.cycles: repeat every 14 days until the serum hCG level becomes undetectable, then give consolidation courses (three additional courses recommended after remission to reduce relapse); physician determined
supportiveCare: leucovorin (folinic acid) rescue is part of the regimen (days 2, 4, 6, 8).
verify adequate renal function before each course (methotrexate is renally cleared); assess for effusions that can sequester methotrexate.
monitor hepatic function; dactinomycin is the standard switch for methotrexate resistance or methotrexate induced liver function abnormalities (DeVita).

monitoring: serum hCG each cycle (response and remission tracking)

doseModificationRules.condition: methotrexate resistance (plateau or rising hCG) or methotrexate induced liver function abnormality
doseModificationRules.text: Switch to single agent dactinomycin per source; if resistant to sequential monotherapy, switch to multiagent EMA-CO (see gyn-gtn-emaco).
Hold and review; methotrexate is renally cleared and can be sequestered in effusions, increasing toxicity.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Table 51.2 Single-Agent Regimens for Low-Risk GTN (lines 176991 to 177010): MTX/FA 8-day = MTX 1 mg/kg IM or IV on days 1, 3, 5, 7 + FA 15 mg PO on days 2, 4, 6, 8; also 5-day MTX 0.4 to 0.5 mg/kg IV or IM daily x 5 (not to exceed 25 mg/d) and pulse MTX 50 mg/m2 IM weekly; MTX/FA is the NETDC first choice given at 2-week intervals (line 177029)

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy for GTN, Regimens for Low-Risk GTN, Preferred Methotrexate (GTN-D 1 of 7; category 1): 8-day 1 mg/kg IM every other day (Days 1, 3, 5, 7) with leucovorin 0.1 mg/kg or 15 mg on Days 2, 4, 6, 8, repeat every 14 days; alternative 0.4 mg/kg/day (max 25 mg/day) IV Push or IM daily x 5 days, repeat every 14 days

sources.name: DeVita 12th ed. (core)
sources.value: Table 51.2 lists pulse MTX 50 mg/m2 IM weekly as an available low-risk single-agent regimen (line 176996)

sources.name: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) GTN
sources.value: GTN-D 1 of 7 lists Methotrexate 30 to 50 mg/m2 IM weekly under NOT RECOMMENDED (lesser efficacy)

divergence.note: The two sources diverge on the weekly intramuscular methotrexate regimen: DeVita Table 51.2 lists it as an option, while the current NCCN v2.2026 explicitly marks weekly methotrexate as NOT RECOMMENDED due to lesser efficacy. This protocol authors the multiday 8-day MTX/FA regimen (preferred, category 1 in both sources) and does NOT use the weekly schedule. Selection of any alternative left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single agent methotrexate (8-day methotrexate/folinic acid) in low risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (StewardMD reference disease gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, subtype group #50). Every dose is source stated. The authored regimen is the 8-day MTX/FA schedule: Methotrexate 1 mg/kg IM (or IV) on days 1, 3, 5, and 7 with Leucovorin 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM on days 2, 4, 6, and 8, given 30 hours after each methotrexate dose, repeated every 14 days, grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia v2.2026, GTN-D 1 of 7 (category 1) and to DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.2 (lines 176991 to 177010, which print the identical MTX 1 mg/kg days 1,3,5,7 plus FA 15 mg days 2,4,6,8). The source stated alternatives (NCCN 5-day methotrexate 0.4 mg/kg/day max 25 mg/day daily x 5 days; DeVita weight based and pulse options) are recorded in evidence and drug notes. A divergence is recorded because DeVita lists weekly methotrexate 50 mg/m2 as an option whereas NCCN v2.2026 marks weekly methotrexate NOT RECOMMENDED; the authored protocol uses neither weekly schedule. Leucovorin rescue is built in and renal function must be verified before each course. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
